tryCatch(

## Overview

The `acd` R package implements a reproducible spatial linkage of Vienna's
building inventory to its
[Area Climate Design (ACD)](https://www.wien.gv.at/stadtentwicklung/energieplanung/)
energy planning zones.

Data snapshot: **`r SNAPSHOT_DATE`**

### What are ACD Zones?

Vienna's *Energieraumplanung* (Energy Area Planning) designates zones where
specific heating and energy rules apply:

| Zone type | Rule example |
|-----------|-------------|
| District heating mandatory | Buildings must connect to the municipal heat network |
| Heat-pump required | No fossil-fuel heating installations permitted |
| Fossil fuel banned | Existing fossil-fuel systems must be retired |

### The Linkage Problem

With approximately 220,000 buildings and dozens of ACD zones, the spatial
join is not trivial. Buildings may:

- Fall cleanly inside a single zone (the ideal case)
- Lie entirely outside any zone (legitimate — no ACD rule applies)
- Straddle a zone boundary (ambiguous legal applicability)
- Fall under multiple overlapping zones simultaneously
- Represent zones with no buildings inside (orphan polygons)
- Have invalid geometry from upstream data errors

See the [Dashboard](vignettes/articles/dashboard.qmd) for interactive
exploration of all six linkage cases.

## Data Sources

| Source | Layer | Provider |
|--------|-------|---------|
| ACD Zones | `ogdwien:ENERGIEPLANERPOGD` | [Vienna OGD WFS](https://data.wien.gv.at/daten/geo) |
| Buildings | `ogdwien:GEBAEUDEOGD` | [Vienna OGD WFS](https://data.wien.gv.at/daten/geo) |

Both layers are fetched at the pinned snapshot date `r SNAPSHOT_DATE` and
committed as Parquet files under `inst/extdata/` for reproducibility.

## Installation

::: {.panel-tabset}

### R

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("JohnGavin/acd_area_climate_design")
```

### Nix

```bash
# Clone and enter the reproducible nix shell
git clone https://github.com/JohnGavin/acd_area_climate_design.git
nix-shell /path/to/acd_area_climate_design/default.nix
```

The `default.nix` provides R 4.5.3 with all dependencies (sf, arrow, leaflet,
DT, gt, etc.) pinned to a specific nixpkgs snapshot for full reproducibility.

:::
